## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
ROTATION, not Risk-Off. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmed by broad sector participation (Materials, Financials, Industrials leading) and strong cyclical names showing ABOVE TREND (FCX, JPM). Major divergence among mega-caps (AAPL, GOOGL, AVGO) warrants caution and suggests tactical, not structural, shifts.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +6.48% | 1M: +22.97%) ABOVE TREND. Financials strong: C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND. Technology also contributes: NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Consumer Discretionary weak: NKE (1W: -7.16% | 1M: -3.71%) BELOW TREND, SBUX (1W: -4.85% | 1M: -0.97%) BELOW TREND. Utilities showing weakness: (sector down 1W). Consumer Staples mixed-to-weak: PEP (1W: -3.74% | 1M: -0.63%) BELOW TREND, KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND; ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND; NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND; AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY; AMD (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +4.30%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology), style: Growth/Momentum.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: TSLA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +13.30%) CORRECTION; MET (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION; MDT (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -8.38%) BELOW TREND; CMCSA (1W: -2.02% | 1M: +11.17%) CORRECTION; KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select consumer and defensive names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W movers: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND; ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND; NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND; AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY; AMD (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +4.30%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence: AAPL (1W: +0.44% | 1M: -1.29%) RECOVERY and GOOGL (1W: +3.65% | 1M: -3.01%) RECOVERY vs broad cyclical strength — watch for follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed but powerful on the upside with narrow leadership; NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +2.25%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +0.44% | 1M: -1.29%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +3.65% | 1M: -3.01%) RECOVERY. Tech internal breadth: Tech: 12/19 positive; sector showing rotation into large, AI-exposed names.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials constructive and broad — JPM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND, MS (1W: +5.15% | 1M: +9.94%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +4.79% | 1M: +12.29%) ABOVE TREND. Financials internal breadth: Financials: 15/20 positive; confirms rotation into cyclicals/value.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mixed defensives with pockets of strength: MRK (1W: +6.05% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +2.38%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.97% | 1M: -2.90%) RECOVERY, JNJ (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +0.46%) CORRECTION. Healthcare internal breadth: Healthcare: 9/15 positive; watch earnings/news-driven idiosyncratic moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclicals/value exposure: Financials (JPM, C, MS), Materials (FCX, NEM) and selected Industrials (BA, CAT) while reducing exposure to narrowly concentrated tech longs that lack breadth confirmation. Given narrow leadership and major mega-cap divergences, keep positions tactical and monitor catalyst-driven follow-through.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: TSLA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +13.30%) CORRECTION, KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND, MDT (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -8.38%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Materials (Materials: 6/7 positive), Financials (Financials: 15/20 positive), Technology (Tech: 12/19 positive). BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (Consumer Disc.: 4/12 positive), Utilities (Utilities: 2/6 positive), Consumer Staples (Consumer Stpl.: 3/11 positive).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA: watch near prior breakout/resistance area (short-term pivot). AAPL: monitor support after RECOVERY (1W: +0.44% | 1M: -1.29%). JPM: track continuation above recent highs to confirm Financials strength (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%). FCX: watch for follow-through on heavy volume rally (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
XOM (+60): XOM (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +4.02%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment (plan upgrade) confirms price action. C (+55): C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND — regulatory relief/asset-sale headlines confirming rally. RTX (+55) noted as bullish in headlines but monitor price action for confirmation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
TSLA (-60): TSLA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +13.30%) CORRECTION — bearish news diverging from strong 1M performance, watch for trend break. KHC (-50): KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms weakness. MDT (-65): MDT (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -8.38%) BELOW TREND — headline-driven downside confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, Growth/Momentum style. NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: leadership is narrow (4/5 Tech in Top 5) and major divergence among mega-caps (AAPL, GOOGL, AVGO) — watch for trend break and news-driven reversals.
